entries.title: HUD Component Overview
entries.why: The HUD (Heads-Up Display) overlays critical information on the 3D view without obscuring the scene. It's the operator's primary interface for monitoring real-time status.
entries.whatItDoes: Imports Zustand store selectors for: connected status, alerts, selected rig/line, view mode. Renders fixed overlay with pointer-events-none (clicks pass through to 3D). Organizes sub-components: ConnectionStatus (top-left), AlertsPanel (top-right), Crosshair (center), QuickStats (bottom-left), Controls (bottom-right).
entries.perfNotes: pointer-events-none prevents HUD from blocking 3D interactions

entries.title: View Mode Toggle (Rig/Ketchup)
entries.why: The system supports two factory simulations: Rig Alpha (industrial machinery) and Ketchup Factory (food processing). Users switch between them to view different production scenarios.
entries.whatItDoes: Two toggle buttons: 'RIG ALPHA' (cyan when active) and 'KETCHUP' (red when active). Clicking calls setViewMode('rig') or setViewMode('ketchup') to switch the Zustand store state.

entries.title: WebSocket Connection Status
entries.why: Real-time monitoring requires a live WebSocket connection. Operators need to see at a glance whether data is flowing or if there's a connection issue.
entries.whatItDoes: Shows green pulsing dot + 'LIVE' when connected, red dot + error message when disconnected. When live, also displays 'Streaming @ 10 Hz' to confirm update rate.

entries.title: Anomaly Alerts Panel
entries.why: When ML detects anomalies, operators need immediate notification with context: which machine, severity, contributing sensors. The alerts panel is the primary notification mechanism.
entries.whatItDoes: Renders scrollable list of alerts (max-height with overflow). Each alert shows: machine/line ID, message, severity (critical=red, warning=yellow), anomaly score percentage, detection method. Dismiss button removes individual alerts.
entries.perfNotes: maxAlerts in store prevents unbounded memory growth

entries.title: Center Crosshair Reticle
entries.why: FPS-style controls need a visual center point for aiming/selecting. The crosshair indicates where clicks will register in the 3D scene.
entries.whatItDoes: Renders centered SVG-style crosshair using Tailwind: outer circle (6x6), center dot (1x1), and four arms (left, right, top, bottom). All in cyan with 40% opacity for subtlety.

entries.title: Rig Quick Stats Panel
entries.why: Operators need at-a-glance status of all three rigs without clicking each one. The quick stats panel shows key metrics (RPM, temp, vibration) for rigs A, B, C.
entries.whatItDoes: Uses useEffect with setInterval (500ms) to poll transient state (avoiding React re-renders). Maps over rigs A/B/C, rendering RigStatRow for each with key metrics and anomaly warnings.
entries.perfNotes: 500ms polling is a tradeoff: not too frequent (perf) but responsive enough (UX)

entries.title: Ketchup Factory Grid Overview
entries.why: The ketchup factory has 25 production lines - too many for detailed rows. A 5x5 grid visualization shows status at a glance with color coding.
entries.whatItDoes: Polls ketchup transient state every 500ms. Renders 5x5 grid where each cell represents one line (L01-L25). Colors: green (normal), red (anomaly), yellow (fill level warning). Summary shows active line count and anomaly count.
entries.perfNotes: Grid rendering is cheap - just 25 small divs

entries.title: Individual Rig Stat Row
entries.why: Each rig needs a consistent display format showing the most important metrics with color-coded warnings for out-of-range values.
entries.whatItDoes: Displays one row: rig letter (A/B/C), RPM (cyan), Temperature (red if > 85°F), Vibration (yellow if > 4.5 mm/s). Shows pulsing '⚠ ANOMALY' badge if anomalyScore > 0.5.

entries.title: Controls Hint & Branding
entries.why: New users need guidance on controls. The hint bar shows keyboard/mouse bindings and provides a link back to the original 2D dashboard.
entries.whatItDoes: Bottom bar showing: 'WASD Move | MOUSE Look | CLICK Select | ESC Deselect'. Also displays version string ('RIG ALPHA DIGITAL TWIN v2.0') and link to localhost:5000 dashboard.

entries.title: Detailed Rig Inspection Panel
entries.why: When a user selects a specific rig (clicks on it in 3D), they want detailed sensor readings. This panel appears on the right side with all relevant parameters.
entries.whatItDoes: Polls selected rig's transient state every 100ms (faster for interactivity). Shows: RPM, Temperature, Vibration, Pressure, Bearing Temp, and Anomaly Score. Color-codes values: green=normal, red=out-of-range.
entries.perfNotes: 100ms polling for selected item - acceptable overhead for 1 item

entries.title: Ketchup Line Inspection Panel
entries.why: Ketchup factory lines have different sensors than industrial rigs: fill level, viscosity, sauce temp, cap torque, etc. This panel shows ketchup-specific parameters.
entries.whatItDoes: Shows: Fill Level (with visual bar), Viscosity, Sauce Temp, Cap Torque, Flow Rate, Label Alignment, Bottle Count, Anomaly Score. Range checks determine color (e.g., fill 88-98% is normal). Shows anomaly type badge if anomaly_score > 0.5.

entries.title: DataRow Helper Component
entries.why: Multiple panels display label/value pairs with conditional coloring. A reusable component reduces code duplication and ensures consistent styling.
entries.whatItDoes: Renders: label (gray) on left, value + unit (green if normal, red if not) on right. Uses Tailwind flexbox for alignment.
